in_marathi.name: Sabita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wise, Intelligent, Beautiful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sabita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sabita is derived from the Sanskrit word Sabitah, which means wise, intelligent, beautiful, or endowed with good qualities. In Hindu mythology, Sabita is an alternate name for the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, music, and the arts. The name is also associated with the Moon, symbolizing calmness, peace, and stability.
